description: Deterministically cast a YOWAYOW Mind-Key hexagram from six evidence-grounded root/body/outcome positions. Use after an autonomous agent has researched a concrete action choice, structural diagnosis, experiment, or macro-structure question. Submit current facts and their manifestation verdicts; never submit yin/yang lines or a desired hexagram. The tool returns cast_ready, needs_evidence, or out_of_scope. It uses no LLM, no random/time casting, and never falls back to traditional liuyao. Do not use for fortune, luck, hidden facts, random outcomes, or as a substitute for high-stakes professional judgment.

constraints.description: Known boundaries such as budget, regulation, capacity, deadlines, or risk limits.

options.description: Existing options. choose_action requires at least two distinct options.

success_criteria.description: Observable criteria that would show the decision worked.

time_horizon.description: Decision horizon, not a divination time seed. Example: next 90 days.

environment.description: Upper trigram: the dominant external constraint or interaction environment.

body.description: Body: current mechanism, coordination, resource flow, or control point.

evidence.description: Evidence for whether this position is currently manifested. Do not submit yin/yang or a desired hexagram.

claim.description: A concrete current fact. Do not put a forecast, recommendation, or hexagram judgment here.

confidence.description: Confidence in this evidence item. At least 0.65 is required to settle a line.
